Hash the stock and patched production execution bytes and prove they are distinct before science.
Use fresh terminal and timing outputs; never relabel or reuse an earlier measurement.

science_contract.shapes: the six exact weighted M32 decode shapes already bound by B200_FP8_RESIDUAL_DISCRIMINATOR.json
